tools.name: Audio Tagger
tools.description: Edit ID3 and Vorbis tags, cover art and filenames in batches.

tools.name: Audio Converter
tools.description: Convert between MP3, AAC/M4A, OGG, Opus, FLAC and WAV, in batches.

tools.name: Picture Converter
tools.description: Convert and resize images between 14 formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF, JPEG XL, TIFF, PDF, BMP, ICO, TGA and more.

tools.name: PDF Toolkit
tools.description: Merge, split, rotate, extract and delete PDF pages, and turn images into a PDF. Nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: Photo Privacy Cleaner
tools.description: See what your photos reveal (location, camera, serial numbers, names) and remove it without touching the picture.

tools.name: Video Converter
tools.description: Convert and shrink videos to MP4, WebM or GIF. Pick a resolution, quality or a target file size, and trim.

tools.name: Music Player
tools.description: Play a folder of music with covers, tags and synced lyrics, word by word for .ttml. Gapless, equalizer, ReplayGain, playlists. Nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: Audio Editor
tools.description: Cut, trim, join, fade and level out audio on a waveform. Always saves a new file; originals are never changed. Nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: Stem Splitter
tools.description: Split a song into vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano and the rest, then pick any combination (voice + bass, drums + guitar...), listen and save it. Runs offline on your computer; nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: Lyrics Maker
tools.description: Listen to a song and write its lyrics with the time every word is sung. Play it with the words lighting up, fix any word, and save word-synced .ttml or a timed .lrc. Works offline in 99 languages; nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: BPM & Key Finder
tools.description: Find the tempo and musical key of your songs, a whole folder at a time, correct them, and write them into the tags (BPM and Initial Key, in musical or Camelot names). Nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: Background Remover
tools.description: Cut the subject out of a picture and keep it transparent or put it on a colour, a blurred copy of the picture or another picture. Fix edges with a brush. Works offline; nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: Duplicate Finder
tools.description: Find duplicate files, look-alike photos and repeated songs, review them, and move the extras to the Recycle Bin. Nothing is deleted for good and nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: Image Text Extractor
tools.description: Read the text in screenshots, photos and scans (OCR) in 12 languages. Copy it or save it as a text file. Works offline; nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: Text & File Diff
tools.description: Compare texts, files and folders side by side, merge changes, and save patches or HTML reports. Offline.

tools.name: Batch File Renamer
tools.description: Rename many files at once with stacked rules, a live preview, clash checks and undo for every batch.

tools.name: Disk Space Visualizer
tools.description: See what fills a drive or folder: a map of boxes, a folder list, the largest files and file types. Clean up to the Recycle Bin.

tools.name: QR & Barcode Studio
tools.description: Make QR codes (Wi-Fi, contacts, links, events) and barcodes (EAN, UPC, Code 128), and read them from pictures or the screen.

tools.name: Password Vault
tools.description: An offline password manager: one encrypted vault file you choose, with a generator, 2FA codes, auto-lock and CSV import.

tools.name: File Encryptor & Hasher
tools.description: Encrypt files and folders with a password, and compute, compare and verify SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-1, MD5 and BLAKE2b checksums.
